keyVerseDR: "The spirit of the Lord is upon me. Wherefore he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor..." (Lk 4:18)

level1.title: Good News for All
level1.story: Jesus went to the synagogue in Nazareth. He read from the scroll of Isaiah: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me." He said, "Today this has come true!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who can you bring good news to?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me share good news. Amen.

activity.title: Luke's Gospel
activity.intro: Luke wrote today's Gospel. Number the four Gospels in order.

level2.title: Today This Is Fulfilled
level2.story: Luke wrote his Gospel so that we may know the truth of what we were taught. Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit. In the synagogue at Nazareth, He opened the book of Isaiah and read, "The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me. Wherefore He hath anointed Me to preach the gospel to the poor." He said He was sent to proclaim release to captives and sight to the blind. Rolling up the book, Jesus said, "This day is fulfilled this scripture in your ears."
level2.keyLine: The spirit of the Lord is upon me.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can you share in Jesus' mission?
level2.prayer: Jesus, anointed One, send me to the poor. Amen.
